notes: Bare-earth ground only: walls/berms narrower than 1 m may be under-represented.
No storm drains: water arriving through pipes is not modeled.
Survey gaps are treated as walls.
Ocean run: water enters only across the PB/MB beach (north of the channel mouth).
bay_berm run: bay shoreline along Bayside Walk (4 m band) raised to 9.0 ft MLLW (assumed effective berm top).
